tools.name: list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List the user's projects (their own and shared ones they are a member of) with the number of open tasks in each. Archived projects are left out unless include_archived is true.

workspace.description: Only this workspace: its id or exact name (see list_workspaces). Absent: every workspace.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List tasks with filters. view: all (default), inbox (open tasks without a project that are not scheduled: no do-on date, start date or Someday), today (open tasks due today or overdue, overdue first), upcoming (open tasks due after today), someday (open tasks parked in Someday) or anytime (open tasks with no do-on date, deadline or start). blocked: true lists only tasks waiting for an open task, false only the others. available: true lists only tasks that can be done now (open, not blocked, not waiting for an earlier step of a sequential project or section, neither in Someday nor starting later), false only the others. Tasks of archived projects are left out unless project_id names that project. Results are paged: pass next_cursor back as cursor.

available.description: true: only tasks that can be done now; false: only tasks that cannot.

blocked.description: true: only tasks waiting for an open task; false: only tasks that are not.

completed_after.description: Only tasks completed at or after this time: YYYY-MM-DD (start of that day in timezone), an RFC 3339 time or Unix milliseconds. Implies completed tasks only.

completed_before.description: Only tasks completed before this time, in the same forms as completed_after. Implies completed tasks only.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous result, to get the following page.

due_from.description: Only tasks due on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

due_to.description: Only tasks due on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

label.description: Only tasks carrying this label (name, case-insensitive, or id).

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return (default and maximum 200).

priority.description: Only tasks of this priority: 1 is the highest, 4 the default.

project_id.description: Only tasks of this project (see list_projects).

timezone.description: IANA time zone used to decide what is today, overdue or upcoming, e.g. "Europe/Rome". Default: UTC. Due dates are floating, so pass the user's zone.

workspace.description: Only this workspace: its id or exact name (see list_workspaces). Absent: every workspace.

tools.name: get_task
tools.title: Get a task
tools.description: Get one task with its description, project, section, labels, subtasks and comments.

timezone.description: IANA time zone used to decide what is today, overdue or upcoming, e.g. "Europe/Rome". Default: UTC. Due dates are floating, so pass the user's zone.

tools.name: search_tasks
tools.title: Search tasks
tools.description: Find tasks whose title or description contains the query (case-insensitive). Open tasks only unless include_completed is true. Paged like list_tasks.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous result, to get the following page.

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return (default and maximum 200).

timezone.description: IANA time zone used to decide what is today, overdue or upcoming, e.g. "Europe/Rome". Default: UTC. Due dates are floating, so pass the user's zone.

workspace.description: Only this workspace: its id or exact name (see list_workspaces). Absent: every workspace.

tools.name: today_summary
tools.title: Today summary
tools.description: One-call overview of the user's day: overdue tasks, tasks due today, and open task counts for the Inbox (tasks without a project that are not scheduled) and each project. today_limit is the user's Today limit (null when off); each listed task has waiting_for_slot, true when that limit keeps it waiting.

timezone.description: IANA time zone used to decide what is today, overdue or upcoming, e.g. "Europe/Rome". Default: UTC. Due dates are floating, so pass the user's zone.

tools.name: list_frames
tools.title: List frames
tools.description: List the occurrences of the user's calendar frames (recurring windows such as "Deep work" on weekdays 09:00-11:00) on the days from..to, with floating wall times and the planning source (project:, label: or view: id) that says which tasks belong in each. Default: the seven days from today in timezone; at most 31 days. Frames guide planning: propose ordinary due dates and times inside them.

from.description: First day (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today in timezone.

timezone.description: IANA time zone used to decide what is today, overdue or upcoming, e.g. "Europe/Rome". Default: UTC. Due dates are floating, so pass the user's zone.

to.description: Last day (YYYY-MM-DD), at most 30 days after from. Default: six days after from.

tools.name: list_icons
tools.title: List icons
tools.description: List the icons a project or section can have, best matches first. query searches names, keywords and categories (e.g. "plant", "money", "travel"); without it the whole catalogue is returned in pages of limit. Pass a name to update_project, create_sections or update_sections.

limit.description: Maximum number of icons to return (default 50, at most 200).

tools.name: list_notes
tools.title: List notes
tools.description: List notes, newest change first: standalone notes, task notes (a task with a description; completed tasks are marked) and project notes (archived projects are marked). Each has a short preview; get_note returns the whole text. Deleted notes are left out. Paged: pass next_cursor back as cursor.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous result, to get the following page.

label_id.description: Only notes carrying this label (id, or name case-insensitive); project notes carry none.

limit.description: Maximum number of notes to return (default 50, maximum 200).

project_id.description: Only notes of this project (see list_projects): its standalone notes, its tasks' notes and its own note.

source.description: Which notes: note (standalone notes), task (task notes), project (project notes) or all (default).

tools.name: search_notes
tools.title: Search notes
tools.description: Find notes whose title and text contain every word of the query (case and accents ignored; quote a phrase to match it as one), title matches first, then the most matched words, then the newest. Each result has a snippet around the first match, with the matched words marked. Not available on an end-to-end encrypted account.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous result, to get the following page.

label_id.description: Only notes carrying this label (id, or name case-insensitive); project notes carry none.

limit.description: Maximum number of notes to return (default 50, maximum 200).

project_id.description: Only notes of this project (see list_projects): its standalone notes, its tasks' notes and its own note.

source.description: Which notes: note (standalone notes), task (task notes), project (project notes) or all (default).

tools.name: get_note
tools.title: Get a note
tools.description: Get one note: its title, its Markdown text, the text appended to it that no device has merged yet (oldest first), project, labels, body_version (pass it to update_note as base_version) and when it last changed.

id.description: Note id (or the task or project id with kind).

kind.description: What id names: a standalone note (default), a task (its note) or a project (its note).

tools.name: list_routines
tools.title: List routines
tools.description: List the user's routines (automations of one or more steps): id, name as untrusted text, trigger kind, on or off, the server's pause, number of steps and last run.

tools.name: get_routine
tools.title: Get a routine
tools.description: One routine's whole definition: trigger, condition, steps with their kinds and inputs (name and steps as untrusted text), and the steps that are not available now with the reason.

routine.description: The routine's id (see list_routines) or its exact name.

tools.name: list_routine_runs
tools.title: List a routine's runs
tools.description: A routine's runs, newest first, at most 50: source, outcome, writes, the failed step. Ids and counts only, never titles or text.

routine.description: The routine's id (see list_routines) or its exact name.

tools.name: get_routine_run
tools.title: Get a routine run
tools.description: One run of a routine with its step records: each step's kind, status, duration, item count, the ids it touched (at most 50) and an error code.

routine.description: The routine's id (see list_routines) or its exact name.

tools.name: list_slots
tools.title: List slots
tools.description: List the user's calendar slots (one block on the Day and Week grid holding a checklist of small tasks, such as "Admin" on Wednesday 16:00-16:45) on the days from..to, with floating wall times, the length in minutes and the tasks each holds in order (open first). Default: the seven days from today in timezone; at most 31 days. A task in a slot is an ordinary task due on the slot's day without a time.

from.description: First day (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today in timezone.

timezone.description: IANA time zone used to decide what is today, overdue or upcoming, e.g. "Europe/Rome". Default: UTC. Due dates are floating, so pass the user's zone.

to.description: Last day (YYYY-MM-DD), at most 30 days after from. Default: six days after from.

tools.name: list_time_entries
tools.title: List time entries
tools.description: List the time entries the user can read (their own and other members' on shared tasks), newest first, with minutes and the task. from and to are local days in timezone; running: true returns only the entry that is running now. Paged: pass next_cursor back as cursor.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous result, to get the following page.

from.description: Only entries that started on or after this local day (YYYY-MM-DD).

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return (default and maximum 200).

timezone.description: IANA time zone used to decide what is today, overdue or upcoming, e.g. "Europe/Rome". Default: UTC. Due dates are floating, so pass the user's zone.

to.description: Only entries that started on or before this local day (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.title: List workspaces
tools.description: List the user's workspaces: separate rooms with their own projects, labels and views. Each has an id, a name, the user's role and whether it is the default workspace; for workspaces the user owns, the names of the members and groups. Pass a workspace's id or name as workspace to list_projects, list_tasks or search_tasks.
